items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: He used to play with Bingle Madison's band at the Tango Palace.

ctx.x: I've forgotten his name, but he's still around. And he was in Canada, he played a whole lot of piano. A big black guy.
A big cat. He used to play with Bingle Madison's band at the Tango Palace.
Yes. Who was that? Did you say he was from Canada?
